description: The agentcv.team.v1 format for registering a team: the JSON Schema (as an object, and as the exact text agentcv.ai/agentcv-team.schema.json serves) and the self-contained prompt from agentcv.ai/register/with-agent that tells an agent how to write the profile. Registration itself is done by a person on agentcv.ai; this server cannot submit anything. Read-only.
name: get_registration_schema
title: Get the AgentCV team-profile format
